metadata.question: Did vegetation cover increase in Warburton Creek between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (primary) over a Warburton Creek AOI in South Australia with two windows around the dates: 2025-06-15..2025-06-25 and 2025-09-10..2025-09-20. If either window has 0 images, fall back to Landsat 8/9 L2; if still empty, widen windows (early: 2025-06-01..2025-07-10, late: 2025-08-25..2025-09-30).
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds (S2 QA60 bits 10/11; Landsat QA_PIXEL cloud/shadow/cirrus/snow) and compute median NDVI composites. Compute valid pixel counts after masking.
3. Logic: Compute mean NDVI and vegetated fraction (NDVI>0.2). If counts==0 → C2; if any null/invalid (NDVI outside [-1,1], vegFrac outside [0,1]) → C3. Vegetation considered increased if veg fraction increased by >0.02.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (eeObj) => new Promise((res, rej) => eeObj.getInfo(res, rej));
  function fmt(n, d=3) { return (n === null || n === undefined) ? 'null' : Number(n).toFixed(d); }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (Warburton Creek AOI bounding box)
  const aoi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [137.0, -27.0],
    [138.7, -27.0],
    [138.7, -28.5],
    [137.0, -28.5],
    [137.0, -27.0]
  ]);

  const earlyStart = '2025-06-15', earlyEnd = '2025-06-25';
  const lateStart = '2025-09-10', lateEnd = '2025-09-20';
  const earlyWideStart = '2025-06-01', earlyWideEnd = '2025-07-10';
  const lateWideStart = '2025-08-25', lateWideEnd = '2025-09-30';
  const vegThresh = 0.2;

  // 2. Sensor-specific functions
  function s2Col(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
  }
  function maskS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function addNdviS2(img) {
    const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).rename('NDVI');
    return img.addBands(ndvi);
  }

  function landsatCol(start, end) {
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end);
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end);
    return l9.merge(l8);
  }
  function scaleL2(img) {
    const refl = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5'])
      .multiply(2.75e-5).subtract(0.2)
      .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    return img.addBands(refl, null, true);
  }
  function maskL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).eq(0) // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<2).eq(0))      // cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5).eq(0))      // snow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<0).eq(0));     // fill
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function addNdviL2(img) {
    const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('NDVI');
    return img.addBands(ndvi);
  }

  async function statsFromCol(col, typeLabel) {
    const size = await getInfo(col.size());
    let cloudMeanProp = 0;
    if (typeLabel === 'S2') {
      cloudMeanProp = await getInfo(ee.Number(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')));
    } else {
      cloudMeanProp = await getInfo(ee.Number(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER')));
    }
    // Build NDVI composite
    let ndviCol = null;
    if (typeLabel === 'S2') {
      ndviCol = col.map(maskS2).map(addNdviS2).select('NDVI');
    } else {
      ndviCol = col.map(maskL2).map(scaleL2).map(addNdviL2).select('NDVI');
    }
    const composite = ndviCol.median();
    const meanDict = await getInfo(composite.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const countDict = await getInfo(composite.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const vfImg = composite.select('NDVI').gt(vegThresh).rename('vf');
    const vfDict = await getInfo(vfImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }));
    const meanNdvi = meanDict ? meanDict.NDVI : null;
    const count = countDict ? countDict.NDVI : 0;
    const vegFrac = vfDict ? vfDict.vf : null;
    return { size: size || 0, cloudMean: cloudMeanProp || 0, meanNdvi, count: count || 0, vegFrac };
  }

  // 3. Try Sentinel-2 first
  let sensorUsed = 'S2';
  let earlyCol = s2Col(earlyStart, earlyEnd);
  let lateCol = s2Col(lateStart, lateEnd);
  let earlySize = await getInfo(earlyCol.size());
  let lateSize = await getInfo(lateCol.size());

  // Fallback if empty
  if (earlySize === 0 || lateSize === 0) {
    sensorUsed = 'Landsat8_9';
    earlyCol = landsatCol(earlyStart, earlyEnd);
    lateCol = landsatCol(lateStart, lateEnd);
    earlySize = await getInfo(earlyCol.size());
    lateSize = await getInfo(lateCol.size());
    if (earlySize === 0 || lateSize === 0) {
      // Widen windows
      earlyCol = landsatCol(earlyWideStart, earlyWideEnd);
      lateCol = landsatCol(lateWideStart, lateWideEnd);
      earlySize = await getInfo(earlyCol.size());
      lateSize = await getInfo(lateCol.size());
      if (earlySize === 0 || lateSize === 0) {
        console.log(`Early Images: ${earlySize || 0}`);
        console.log(`Late Images: ${lateSize || 0}`);
        console.log('Sensor: Landsat8_9 (widened)');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
        console.log('C1'); // final tag
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Processing and stats
  const earlyStats = await statsFromCol(earlyCol, sensorUsed === 'S2' ? 'S2' : 'Landsat');
  const lateStats = await statsFromCol(lateCol, sensorUsed === 'S2' ? 'S2' : 'Landsat');

  // 5. Validate pixel counts
  if ((earlyStats.count || 0) === 0 || (lateStats.count || 0) === 0) {
    console.log(`Sensor: ${sensorUsed}`);
    console.log(`Early Images: ${earlyStats.size} (avgCloud: ${fmt(earlyStats.cloudMean,1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Late Images: ${lateStats.size} (avgCloud: ${fmt(lateStats.cloudMean,1)}%)`);
    console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
    console.log('C2'); // final tag
    return;
  }

  // 6. Validate results (null/invalid)
  const invalid =
    earlyStats.meanNdvi === null || lateStats.meanNdvi === null ||
    earlyStats.vegFrac === null || lateStats.vegFrac === null ||
    earlyStats.meanNdvi < -1 || earlyStats.meanNdvi > 1 ||
    lateStats.meanNdvi < -1 || lateStats.meanNdvi > 1 ||
    earlyStats.vegFrac < 0 || earlyStats.vegFrac > 1 ||
    lateStats.vegFrac < 0 || lateStats.vegFrac > 1;

  if (invalid) {
    console.log(`Sensor: ${sensorUsed}`);
    console.log('C3'); // Calculation failure
    return;
  }

  // 7. Decision: vegetation increased if veg fraction increased by > 0.02
  const dNdvi = lateStats.meanNdvi - earlyStats.meanNdvi;
  const dVeg = lateStats.vegFrac - earlyStats.vegFrac;
  const increased = dVeg > 0.02;

  // 8. Output concise evidence (<=20 lines)
  console.log(`Sensor: ${sensorUsed}`);
  console.log(`Early (${earlyStart}..${earlyEnd}) Images: ${earlyStats.size} (avgCloud: ${fmt(earlyStats.cloudMean,1)}%), Valid Px: ${earlyStats.count}`);
  console.log(`Late  (${lateStart}..${lateEnd}) Images: ${lateStats.size} (avgCloud: ${fmt(lateStats.cloudMean,1)}%), Valid Px: ${lateStats.count}`);
  console.log(`Early NDVI mean: ${fmt(earlyStats.meanNdvi)}, VegFrac(>0.2): ${fmt(earlyStats.vegFrac)}`);
  console.log(`Late  NDVI mean: ${fmt(lateStats.meanNdvi)}, VegFrac(>0.2): ${fmt(lateStats.vegFrac)}`);
  console.log(`ΔNDVI: ${fmt(dNdvi)}, ΔVegFrac: ${fmt(dVeg)}`);
  console.log(increased ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
}

async function initEE() {
  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
    });
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
    });
    await runAnalysis();
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D'); // Error in initialization or API
  }
}

initEE();
```
